indications.name: Adults with previously treated, unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring a fibroblast growth factor receptor 2 (FGFR2) fusion or other rearrangement
indications.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-11-20: Confirmed by the ORIG-1 approval letter; the original label (ORIG-1) lists it.

evidence.quote: This NDA provides for the use of Lyrfigtu (lirafugratinib) capsule for the treatment of adults with previously treated, unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring a fibroblast growth factor receptor 2 (FGFR2) fusion or other rearrangement.

pivotal.indication: Adults with previously treated, unresectable, locally advanced or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma harboring a fibroblast growth factor receptor 2 (FGFR2) fusion or other rearrangement
